lede: The headline today was mathematical: a claimed proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis drew 2,499 points on Hacker News, and the Riemann hypothesis itself pulled 295,157 views on Wikipedia. The day's single biggest draw was Grand Theft Auto VI, topping Wikipedia at 540,793 views. Meanwhile an AI driven sell-off pushed the S&P 500 into a correction.

throughlines.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini
throughlines.gist: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini surfaced on both Hacker News and Hugging Face at once, a compact model pulling developer attention across the discussion board and the model hub.

throughlines.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
throughlines.gist: Grand Theft Auto VI led Wikipedia at 540,793 views while the Grand Theft Auto series held near the top of Steam's live player counts, a reminder that one franchise can carry both an encyclopedia and a storefront on the same day.

throughlines.title: Riemann hypothesis
throughlines.gist: A claimed proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis sent readers to both Hacker News and Wikipedia, where the Riemann hypothesis drew 295,157 views, rare company for a math problem first posed in 1859.
